title: KITHD_BASE_URL read from env on every request, unsanitized, emitted in JMAP session
description: kithd/src/lib.rs:78-83 session_handler re-reads KITHD_BASE_URL from the process environment on every request rather than from Config. The value is emitted verbatim in the JMAP session object. A misconfigured value (javascript: URI, data: URI) could inject unexpected URLs into session responses. Config is not the single source of truth — base_url can change at runtime without restart. Fix: parse and validate base_url in Config::from_env (must start with https://, must parse as URL), store in Config, and read from there in session_handler.
